The grace branch first uses SDK PUT to create two real versions and verifies that the shards are complete. The original task must finish inside the window and report exactly the old version as deferred, the current version as verified_healthy, and retryNotBefore. After naturally waiting out the expiry, the original token is still unchanged, and only a new token may clean up the old version.
